description: Rename the product's human-readable name from 'Digital Monster / デジタルモンスター' to 'AI Monster / AIモンスター' across user-facing frontend strings, backend/shared copy, docs, package descriptions, and .kiro prose. PRESERVE all infra identifiers, directory paths, npm scopes, and TypeScript type identifiers so the deployed AWS stack and build are unaffected. This is one coherent same-pattern rename across many files. First confirm the green baseline (npm run build, npm test, frontend game-ui tests), then make edits, then re-verify including cdk synth stability for any infra edit.
steps: Setup/baseline: export PATH if needed (export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"). From repo root run `npm run build` (expect exit 0), `npm test` (expect 47 pass), and the frontend game-ui tests (expect 50 pass). Record baseline. Create branch `feat/rename-ai-monster` off main.

Frontend i18n: in packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts set app.title JA (line ~33) from 'デジタルモンスター育成' to 'AIモンスター育成', and app.title EN (line ~106) from 'Digital Monster Raising' to 'AI Monster Raising'. Keep JA/EN key parity.
Frontend test: in packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts update lines ~426-427 assertions to expect 'AIモンスター育成' (ja) and 'AI Monster Raising' (en) so they match the new i18n values.
Frontend page title: in packages/frontend/index.html change <title>デジタルモンスター育成</title> to <title>AIモンスター育成</title>.

Monster sprite tooltips: in packages/frontend/src/assets/monsters/Baby.tsx, Rookie.tsx, Champion.tsx, Ultimate.tsx change the default `title` prop JA strings '幼年期のデジタルモンスター'/'成長期のデジタルモンスター'/'成熟期のデジタルモンスター'/'完全体のデジタルモンスター' to use 'AIモンスター' instead of 'デジタルモンスター' (e.g. '幼年期のAIモンスター'). Keep the stage prefixes.
Frontend api doc comment: packages/frontend/src/api.ts line ~2 'Typed fetch client for the Digital Monster backend.' -> 'AI Monster backend'.

Backend chat prompts: packages/backend/src/handlers/chat.ts line ~37 'You are a digital monster named ...' -> 'You are an AI monster named ...'; line ~46 'あなたは「...」という名前のデジタルモンスターです。' -> '...という名前のAIモンスターです。'. These are user-visible prompt strings; keep ${context.name} interpolation intact.
Shared doc comment: packages/shared/src/types.ts line ~2 'Core domain types for the Digital Monster game.' -> 'AI Monster game'. Do NOT rename any TypeScript type/interface identifiers.

Package descriptions: root package.json `description` 'Digital Monster - a Digimon-style ...' -> 'AI Monster - a Digimon-style ...'. KEEP root `name` as 'kiro-digitalmonster' (repo identifier, referenced by SUBMISSION.md). infra/package.json `description` 'AWS CDK (TypeScript) infrastructure for the Digital Monster game: ...' -> 'AI Monster game'. Do NOT change any @ddm/* workspace package names.

Infra description string ONLY: infra/bin/app.ts line ~42 the stack `description` string 'Digital Monster (Digimon-style raising game): ...' -> 'AI Monster (Digimon-style raising game): ...'. CRITICAL: do NOT change the stack ID literal "DigitalMonsterStack" (2nd arg to new DigitalMonsterStack), the class name, the import path, or anything that alters logical IDs.

Infra comments ONLY (optional, cosmetic): in infra/lib/digital-monster-stack.ts you may update the prose comment on line ~68 'The complete Digital Monster infrastructure:' -> 'AI Monster'. Do NOT rename the class DigitalMonsterStack, interface DigitalMonsterStackProps, the file name, or any construct/logical IDs. Leave the comment on line ~56 that cites the file path 'infra/lib/digital-monster-stack.ts' as-is.

Docs: README.md line 1 '# デジタルモンスター / Digital Monster 🥚🐉' -> '# AIモンスター / AI Monster 🥚🐉'. Leave README lines that reference the file path infra/lib/digital-monster-stack.ts unchanged (those are paths, not the product name). SUBMISSION.md line 3 prose 'デジタルモンスター' (the product name within the sentence) -> 'AIモンスター'; KEEP the repo name token **kiro-digitalmonster** and all .kiro/specs/digital-monster/ and .agents/tasks/task-digital-monster/ path references unchanged.

.kiro prose: update ONLY product-name prose, never directory paths. .kiro/powers/digimon-helper/power.json `description` 'デジタルモンスター育成ゲーム...' -> 'AIモンスター育成ゲーム...' (keep author 'kiro-digitalmonster' and the power/skill directory names). .kiro/specs/digital-monster/design.md line 1 '— デジタルモンスター' -> '— AIモンスター'; requirements.md line 1 '— デジタルモンスター' -> '— AIモンスター'; tasks.md line 1 '— デジタルモンスター' -> '— AIモンスター'. Leave all 'infra/lib/digital-monster-stack.ts', '.kiro/specs/digital-monster/', '.agents/tasks/task-digital-monster/' path strings in these files (and in .kiro/hooks/README.md, .kiro/steering/structure.md, skills/add-growth-stage.md) unchanged because they are filesystem paths.

Re-verify: run `npm run build` (exit 0, i18n parity), `npm test` (47), frontend game-ui tests (50). Then run `cd infra && npx cdk synth` and confirm the output stack is still named DigitalMonsterStack with identical logical/resource IDs (compare resource keys to infra/cdk.out/DigitalMonsterStack.template.json). Only the stack Description metadata should differ.

Audit: re-run `grep -rniE "digital[ -]?monster|デジタルモンスター" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.json --include=*.md --include=*.html .` excluding node_modules, dist, cdk.out, package-lock.json, and the .agents/ and intentionally-preserved paths; confirm every remaining hit is a deliberately preserved identifier/path (stack class/ID, file paths, directory names, repo name token, @ddm scope). Record the preserved list in findings.
Commit on feat/rename-ai-monster with well-separated, descriptive commits (e.g. frontend strings, backend/shared copy, docs, package+infra descriptions, .kiro prose). Do NOT push or open a PR.
